messages:
Mira P.: Quick flag 00: running into pyright noise in a sample app. Using python-sdk v0.9.1 and the streaming chat API:
```py
async for chunk in client.chat.stream(prompt="hey"):
    print(chunk.text)  # pyright: Property 'text' does not exist on type 'dict'
```
The generated SDK yields raw dicts for stream chunks which breaks typed consumers.

Jordan L.: Oof. I saw a couple teams wrapping stream events with TypedDict locally. Not ideal long term. Does generator emit any pyi stubs?

Raf (sdk): Current generator produces runtime BaseModel-like classes but for streaming we just pass through JSON and annotate as Any/Iterator[Any]. We didn't want to couple the stream wire format to models because of perf.

Mira P.: Understand perf tradeoff, but even a small TypedChunk TypedDict with optional fields would stop pyright/mypy from screaming. pyright is especially brutal for property access in tight loops.

Lucy (devex): From onboarding feedback: new users expect the examples/ folder to be mypy/pyright-clean. Could we add examples/typed_stream.py and a mypy config for CI that checks examples? Also a section in docs on how to get typed streaming vs raw.

Raf (sdk): Proposal idea:
- Introduce TypedChunk TypedDict with keys we know (text: str, role: Optional[str], delta: Optional[dict])
- Change async iterator type to AsyncIterator[TypedChunk] but keep low-overhead path where return_raw_stream=True skips model conversion
- Generate .pyi stubs for public client surface so strict typecheckers get good signatures without heavy runtime changes
- Add a lightweight conversion that only wraps top-level keys, avoid full pydantic parsing for perf-sensitive streams

Jordan L.: .pyi stubs would be huge for adoption. Some teams vendored a stub-only package previously. Make sure stubs reflect generic Response[T] pattern as well.

Mira P.: Also running into missing types on params (e.g., temperature: float | None). The generator emitted temperature: Any on some ops. Causes mypy to accept nonsense.

Raf (sdk): We'll audit param type mappings and map number/integer/boolean/string to the appropriate Python types and use Optional[...] for nullable fields. For unions we'll try to emit Union[...] when feasible.

typebot: Created issue SDK-2021: "python-sdk: typed streaming chunks + stub generation + stricter param typing" assigned to @raf_sdk

Lucy (devex): Can we include a note about pydantic v1/v2 compatibility and the minimum supported versions in the README? A lot of users get surprise import errors.

Raf (sdk): Yep. We'll add pydantic_version detection in generated runtime helpers and emit legacy-compatible aliases when necessary. Plan to land a minimal change in a 0.9.x patch and full stubs + examples in 0.10.0-alpha.

Mira P.: I'll prototype examples/typed_stream.py and run it under pyright; will paste results here once done. Small win: typed streaming will unblock a couple internal demo apps.

Jordan L.: Thanks 00! Also let's document how to opt into raw dicts (return_raw_stream flag), as some users will prefer speed over typing.

Raf (sdk): Agreed. Adding the flag and docs. Will follow up with PR that includes a .pyi generator and example.

Lucy (devex): Love it. Please cc devex on the PR so we can add the example to onboarding checklist.

typebot: SDK-2021 updated: labels [typing, dx, priority-medium].
